name: ch.opencaselaw/swiss-caselaw
title: OpenCaseLaw — Swiss Caselaw, Statutes & Doctrine
description: 973,000+ published Swiss court decisions (federal + cantonal, 1875–today, DE/FR/IT), 5,500 federal + 15,700 cantonal statutes, 1,058 scholarly commentaries, 30,000+ open-access scholarship records, 8.09M-edge citation graph. 38 specialised tools: full-text search with cross-language matching, citation graph + appeal-chain traversal, statute & commentary lookup, doctrinal timelines, leading-case discovery, verbatim Erwägung extraction, scholarship search. Built around a 6-layer verification architecture (cite/check_claim_support/attest_response) that catches AI hallucination of case references before answers ship. Daily refresh, CC0 data, MIT code, no API key, no registration.
